BIOLOGY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BIOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

3. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

4. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination in Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination in Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination in Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination in Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination in Animals.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Evolution? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Evolution.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Evolution.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Evolution.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Evolution.

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support in Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support in Plants.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support in Plants.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Support in Plants.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support in Plants.

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Heating until a solid melts

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Genetics? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Genetics.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Genetics.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Genetics.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Genetics.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support and Movement in Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support and Movement in Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support and Movement in Animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support and Movement in Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Support and Movement in Animals.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination in Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination in Plants.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination in Plants.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination in Plants.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination in Plants.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.

18. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

19. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

20. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

30. In three clear sentences, explain Evolution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
